sentences.text: None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.
2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by the judgment and order dated 19.07.1997 passed by Special Judge (Anti Corruption), Gorakhpur.

The Sixth Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gorakhpur vide order dated 04.09.1993 convicted revisionist and sentenced him to undergo six months rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs. 1000/- under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (hereinafter referred to as ?Act, 1954?)
and one week imprisonment and fine of Rs. 300/- under Rule 50 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Rules, 1955 (hereinafter referred to as ?Rules, 1955?).

entities.text: Sixth Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gorakhpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Thereagainst, revisionist preferred Criminal Appeal No. 55 of 1993 and Appellate Court while allowing appeal partly confirmed the conviction and sentence passed under Section 7/16 of Act, 1954 but set aside the conviction and sentence passed under Rule 50 of of Rules, 1955.
Being aggrieved the revisionist preferred present revision.
